Alex W: Heads up — release cutoff in ~8h for v2.4.0. Need version bumps, changelog entry, docs check, and security sign-off. Flag blockers now.
Parul: Quick checklist I added: 1) version bump PR 2) changelog draft 3) docs snippet 4) security scan 5) QA canary. I can triage PRs.
Matt: Version bump PR is ready (PR #3487). It's a small API param rename. @Tara can you review when free?
Tara: Yup, I'll take a look. Docs will need one short snippet for the new param — I'll update after review.
Chris: QA plans canary at 10:30 PST. @qa-bot can you schedule it and post results here?
qa-bot: Canary run scheduled for 1779123600. Will post pass/fail + logs to this thread.
Alex W: Security sign-off status? @security-team
security-team: Quick dependency scan done; no high vulns. One callout: telemetry opt-out behavior changed — we want a note in the release notes and doc callout. Otherwise clear.
Parul: Added a changelog draft in the changelogs folder (link: https://internal/redwood/changelogs/v2.4.0-draft). Please add sentences for your components.
Matt: Reading the draft now — :thumbsup: LGTM. I added one line about the API param rename.
Tara: Docs updated in PR #3491 with the snippet and telemetry note. Small wording tweak pushed.
Alex W: Great. If canary passes + docs updated + security note included, I'll cut the tag at cutoff. Any objections?
Chris: No objections from QA. We'll run post-canary smoke tests and report back.
release-bot: Reminder: release window starts 2026-03-18T18:00Z. Auto-merges are disabled during the window.
Parul: I'll handle cherry-picks to stable after the tag; will post PRs here for review.
Alex W: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll watch the canary results and post the tag command here once green. :rocket:
qa-bot: Canary finished: PASS. Key checks: latency smoke ok, critical flows exercised (login, generate, embeddings). Logs: https://internal/ci/canary/1779123600
Tara: Verified the docs render in the site preview. Minor typo fixed.
security-team: Confirmed release notes include telemetry opt-out note.
Matt: All set from my side.
Parul: Cherry-picks queued (PRs #3502, #3503). Will merge after tag.
Alex W: Tagging the release now: `git tag v2.4.0 && git push origin v2.4.0` — initiating. Will follow up with rollout notes.
Chris: Post-release smoke OK. No regressions reported.
Alex W: Closing thread — thanks all. If anything pops up, report in #incidents but ping me for immediate attention.
